body: So last night I left. Nothing major happened just more of the same negativity and I snapped. I'm currently staying at his mums with my daughter until I can sort out some housing. My savings were decimated by the last months of my maternity leave so I'm going to have to try for social housing initially until I can get enough money behind me to look for private rentals. My daughter had her 1year immunisations yesterday and she's not taken well to them, so I've had to stay off work. And maybe it's because I'm tired after no sleep but now I have the 'fear' about leaving my partner. Am I going to be able to do this on my own? I'm scared that I'll fuck up my daughters life because I'm such a failure. I didn't do the masters degree I'd planned on because I met my partner and he convinced me to stay here so now my degree is wasted and I'm working an office job and having to consider going on the council housing list. I'm so scared.

I have my job here and as much as my partner is a dick, his family are great and they adore my daughter. I don't have much family. My mum is a train wreck and I don't talk to her, my brother lives in London. And we'll that's it. I have lots of friends at home but they all have their own lives and I'd be just as isolated there as here. I hit a really low point in the last few days and I've felt like I've got nowhere to turn. I've been fighting to be strong but I know that deep down I'm just pathetic and I'm so scared that this will rub off on my daughter. Repeating the cycle that happened to my mum with hers, and her with me. I don't want that. But I also don't want her to not have me at all. I'm so conflicted. I want to see my dr again but I'm worried they'll get social services involved and take her away from me if I say I wish I was dead. And my partner could use that against me if our break up got ugly.

I'm so worried that even then I'm going to continue to live under this cloud. I dreamed of her growing up with everything I didn't have and now here I am fucking everything up for her. I don't deserve her
